title: Measurement of autophagy via LC3 western blotting following DNA-damage-induced senescence
protocol: Dilute the doxorubicin stock solution 1:1000 in culture medium to obtain a final concentration of 150 ng/mL.
Wash each well twice with 2 mL of PBS and remove the wash solution.
Add 2 mL of the doxorubicin solution per well.
Maintain the wells at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a humidified chamber for 5 or 10 days.
Do not change the culture medium during the treatment period.
Prepare samples for SA-β-gal staining.
Perform Western blot analysis for p21.
Perform Western blot analysis for LAMP1.
Perform Western blot analysis for Lamin B1.
Wash each dish with 2 mL of PBS, then remove the wash solution.
Add 2 mL of 1× Fixation Buffer and incubate for 7 min at room temperature.
Wash each dish 3 times with 2 mL of PBS.
Scrape each well on ice after adding 25 μL of lysis buffer to the wells.
Centrifuge samples at 20,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Measure the protein concentration using Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit.
Adjust the protein concentration among all samples using lysis buffer and mix well with 5× SDS-sample buffer.
Heat the samples at 95°C for 7 min, then place the tube at room temperature for 5 min.
Transfer the micro cover glass with fixed cells into a 24-well plate filled with PBS.
Remove the PBS from the well.
Add 1 mL of Staining mixture containing X-gal Solution to the well.
Seal the plate with Parafilm.
Incubate the cells at 37°C for 16–20 hours without CO2.
Wash the cells three times with 1 mL of PBS.
Cover the cells with Mounting Medium with DAPI.
Observe the cells on DIC and DAPI images using Olympus cellSens Standard Imaging Software at 100× magnification.
Count more than 200 DAPI-positive cells manually.
Calculate the percentage of SA-β-gal positive cells per condition in each experiment.
Load 10–20 μg of total protein.
Stain the protein to PVDF membrane with Ponceau S to confirm equal blotting among samples.
Block the membrane with 1% skim milk for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate overnight at 4°C in primary antibody.
Incubate with appropriate HRP-conjugated secondary antibody at room temperature for an hour.
Develop blots with Immobilon Forte Western HRP Substrate or ImmunoStar LD.
Detect signals using ChemiDocTM Touch Imaging System (Bio-Rad).
Wash the membrane with TBST and ddH2O after incubation steps.
Dry the membrane to store it at room temperature for reuse on other senescence markers.
Assess cell cycle arrest and mitochondrial dysfunction, such as by using Click-iT® EdU Imaging Kit and XF Cell Mito Stress Test Kit.
Dilute the bafilomycin A1 stock solution or DMSO 1:1250 in culture medium to obtain the bafilomycin A1 (the final concentration is 200 nM) or DMSO solution.
Wash each well twice with 2 mL of PBS, then remove the wash solution.
Add 2 mL of culture medium with bafilomycin A1 or DMSO solution.
Incubate the cells for 2 h at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a humidified chamber.
